$comment: Customer journeys as code (docs/product-analytics.md). Steps are event names from config/events.json, in order. `pnpm journeys:sync` turns each journey into a PostHog funnel insight plus a threshold alert (conversion below minConversion) and an Umami funnel; `pnpm journeys:report` prints the current funnel. windowDays: how long a user has to finish the journey. minConversion: overall first-to-last-step conversion in percent below which the PostHog alert fires. maxStepSeconds: target time per step, reported (median from PostHog) but not alerted on.

journeys.description: A new visitor signs up, creates an organization and a first project.
